plan.notes: Source: the official 'Computer Science Bachelor of Science Pathway | UC Santa Cruz 2026' at https://programmaps.ucsc.edu/pathway/computer-science-from-high-school-2/ — the UCSC General Catalog's Computer Science B.S. page (https://catalog.ucsc.edu/en/current/general-catalog/academic-units/baskin-engineering/computer-science-and-engineering/computer-science-bs/) states 'Academic planners for this and all majors can be found at programmaps.ucsc.edu,' making this the catalog-sanctioned official term-by-term sequence for the from-high-school (frosh) track. Course titles and credit values are verbatim from the pathway tables. Catalog year: 2026-2027 (program map titled 'UC Santa Cruz 2026'; verified course pages render under the '2026-2027 UCSC General Catalog' breadcrumb). Transcription method: manual, table-by-table transcription of the official 12-quarter (Fall/Winter/Spring x 4 years) pathway; prereqs verified against 2026-2027 General Catalog course listings and official Baskin Engineering course pages, with 'or' alternatives simplified to the standard in-plan track (every listed prereq code names a course in this plan). Placement/assessment items (the pathway's 'Placement Assessments' advising note; math-placement alternatives in course prereqs) are described here, not in external_prereqs. QUARTER SYSTEM: UCSC runs on quarters; the pathway's own unit sum is exactly 180 quarter units (term blocks 16+17+17+14+15+15+15+15+15+15+15+11 = 180, including the 1-credit Summer Orientation), the official bachelor's minimum. CAVEATS: (1) This models the standard frosh-entry pathway; the catalog also publishes an alternative first-year plan for students without programming experience and a transfer plan — not modeled here. (2) The optional 'Summer Edge' early-start advising item from the pathway is not modeled. (3) GE choice slots (Cross-Cultural Analysis, Practice, Ethnicity and Race, Interpreting Arts and Media, Textual Analysis, Perspectives), College Core, and elective slots are student-choice; the pathway names only the GE category, not specific courses. (4) ELWR is typically WRIT 1/WRIT 1E and may be satisfied by exam/AP credit; College Core is specific to the student's residential college. (5) Prereqs are published per-course in the catalog, not on the pathway page; only catalog-verified prereqs are listed (see per-course choice_notes); the pathway's term order is itself the official sequence. external_prereqs is empty: every listed prereq names a course in this plan.
